name: Family Secrets
source: Alex's life seems like a dream come true. He is eighteen, has a scholarship to a prestigious university, and an invitation to live in his Aunt Nicole's luxurious mansion. But behind the facade of wealth lies a dark secret. Three years ago, the head of the family, Joseph, vanished without a trace in the labyrinths of his international business. The police gave up, but the family remains silent. Upon entering a house where every cupboard hides a skeleton, Alex quickly realises that his relatives conceal much behind masks of hospitality. Charm is wielded as a weapon here. And innocence is merely a convenient disguise. You are about to plunge into a web of lies and half-truths woven by those closest to you. Are you ready to discover what lurks behind the closed doors of this house's bedrooms?
translation: 亚历克斯的生活似乎梦想成真。他十八岁了，获得了一所著名大学的奖学金，并受邀住在他姨妈妮可的豪华豪宅里。但在财富的外表背后却隐藏着一个黑暗的秘密。三年前，一家之主约瑟夫在他的国际生意迷宫中消失得无影无踪。警察放弃了，但家人仍然保持沉默。进入一所每个橱柜都藏着一具骷髅的房子后，亚历克斯很快意识到他的亲戚在热情好客的面具后面隐藏了很多东西。魅力在这里被用作武器。而纯真只是一种方便的伪装。你即将陷入由你最亲近的人编织的谎言和半真半假的网络。你准备好去发现这座房子紧闭的卧室门后面潜藏着什么吗？
